title: Will Mamdani sign above 0 executive orders between Oct 18, 2026 and Oct 24, 2026?
rules: If the number of non-emergency executive orders signed by Zohran Mamdani is above 0 from Oct 18, 2026 to Oct 24, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: Mamdani has signed regular (non-emergency) executive orders at a high pace: 11 in his first two weeks, more in February, two on Sept 4, and a worker-protection order in October 2026. Outside January, the pace looks like about one a week, but orders come in clusters, so many single weeks have none. I couldn't confirm whether one was signed during Oct 18–24, so I put it near a coin flip, nudged up slightly for the activity in October.
blind.falsifier: The NYC Mayor's Office list of executive orders shows no new numbered (non-emergency) order dated October 18–24, 2026 (which would make it NO), or shows one dated in that window, e.g. the worker-power order (which would make it YES).

final.reasoning: My earlier 0.52 rested only on a weekly signing rate, not on any check of October 18–24, while the market at 0.23 may reflect traders watching the official order list and seeing nothing new. I'm moving most of the way toward the price and passing, since the remaining gap doesn't justify a bet.
